items.headline: Wangchuk says he is under house arrest
items.text: Activist Sonam Wangchuk says about 20 armed personnel keep him home in Leh after he opposed holding council polls on 4 December. Police said he was advised to stay home under election prohibitory orders.

photo.alt: A town of low buildings and bare poplar trees in a dry valley, with snow-capped mountains behind.
photo.caption: Leh town, Ladakh, seen from above in 2015.

items.place: Chenab valley forests, Kishtwar, Jammu and Kashmir
items.headline: Two special police officers found shot dead
items.text: Special police officers Rashpal Kumar, 45, and Bobby Chand, 57, were found dead with bullet wounds in Kishtwar's forests a day after going missing; their rifles were reportedly gone. Police confirmed the recovery.

photo.alt: A wide snow-covered ground with small figures, a line of bare trees and town buildings, below snowy mountains.
photo.caption: Chowgan ground in Kishtwar town after snowfall, in 2018.

items.place: Allahabad High Court (Lucknow bench), Uttar Pradesh
items.headline: Court: UP police probes left 'hanging fire'
items.text: The Allahabad High Court said stalled police probes appear statewide, citing a Sultanpur murder case pending eight months, and sought the home department's remedy within three weeks. The state said investigation continues.

photo.alt: A red sandstone court building with domed towers, white trim and a sign in Hindi, behind trees.
photo.caption: The Allahabad High Court's Lucknow bench in 2013.

items.headline: Prosecution of two IAS officers sanctioned
items.text: The Centre sanctioned prosecuting two IAS officers in a road-tender case, the Madras High Court heard; officials blamed the delay on bulky files. The judge said things 'move fast for poor people'.

photo.alt: A red Indo-Saracenic building with two tall domed towers and an arched entrance, with cars and auto-rickshaws in front.
photo.caption: The Madras High Court in Chennai in January 2026.

items.headline: Hospital strike kills six; baby dies of cold
items.text: A strike on Khan Younis's Nasser Hospital killed six, including a surgeon and a boy of 13, medics said; Israel's military said it targeted a Hamas commander. A nine-month-old died of hypothermia in a tent.

photo.alt: A wide field of rubble and collapsed buildings under a low sun, with a few people walking through.
photo.caption: Ruins in Khan Younis in December 2024.

items.place: Atara, north of Ramallah, West Bank
items.headline: Settlers wound five after army clears outposts
items.text: Settlers wounded five Palestinians in Atara, one seriously, Yesh Din said, after troops removed two nearby outposts. The army said 'Israeli rioters' barricaded themselves inside structures and were dispersed.

photo.alt: An old domed stone shrine behind low stone walls and trees, under a blue sky.
photo.caption: The Sheikh al-Qatrawani shrine near Atara, in 2021.

items.headline: WFP: 900,000 lose food aid in Sudan
items.text: Funding cuts shrank WFP's reach in Sudan from over 4 million people in August to just over 3 million, its new chief said on a first visit; it needs $520 million through April.

photo.alt: Women and children set up shelters of cloth and sticks on open sandy ground, with rocky hills behind.
photo.caption: Newly displaced people from El Fasher set up shelter in Tawila, North Darfur, in October 2025.

items.headline: UN: 1,167 killed in Haiti in three months
items.text: A UN report counts at least 1,167 killed in Haiti, July to September. Gangs caused over 45% of incidents; over half the killings came in security operations against gangs. No government response was reported.

photo.alt: A busy street with crowds walking past stalls of clothes and goods, shop signs and low buildings.
photo.caption: A street in Port-au-Prince in 2012.

items.headline: Spain housing strike: 75 held, rubber bullets fired
items.text: Police reported at least 75 arrests and 1,044 incidents in Wednesday's housing general strike, firing rubber bullets in Madrid and foam rounds in Barcelona amid barricades and burning bins; marches drew thousands.

photo.alt: Marchers at night hold a long white banner reading 'Bloque Crítico por la huelga general'.
photo.caption: A general-strike march in Madrid on 14 November 2012, Spain's last general strike before this one.

items.headline: HRW seeks inquiry into Yogyakarta protest force
items.text: HRW urged an impartial inquiry into rubber bullets, tear gas and beatings at Yogyakarta protests on 10 November; police held 157 and freed 154, and say protesters threw rocks and firebombs.

photo.alt: A large cream university building with long rows of windows, behind lawns and pine trees.
photo.caption: Gadjah Mada University's central building in Yogyakarta, in 2020; HRW says police entered the campus.

focus.title: Palestine: Gaza and the West Bank
focus.dek: A strike on Nasser Hospital killed six, medics said, and a baby died of cold in a tent; Gaza's health ministry counts over 1,600 killed since the October 2025 ceasefire.
focus.alt: A wide field of rubble and collapsed buildings under a low sun, with a few people walking through.
